subject: alt-ft
title: ALT.FT.------AFI.
description: Chart on book p. 101 (CS-29). ALT-FT (alternative functionalism) is the subject; AFI (affinity insight) is the partner. From the subject: TRS (transition), RT-DY (reality dynamics), COS-P (cosmic particulars) and POST (postulation). From TRS: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DY: TECH-DY (technological dynamics). From RT-DY: INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INTR: JR-DY (journalism dynamics). From COS-P: ATTN (attraction). From POST: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics). The label POST has no dot of its own; it sits on the line to SPT-DY.
